title: Manual four-person Pager order
summary: Keeps the four-person Pager order completely manual instead of preselecting names from theatre parts.
changes: A new four-person Shared Pager order now starts with four explicit Select nurse fields rather than prefilled names.
The app no longer assumes that Pager order should follow First Part or Second Part theatre order.
Each working nurse can be selected only once, and Save remains unavailable until all four Pager parts are assigned.
Existing saved Pager orders remain visible and editable, so previously agreed plans are not lost.
The theatre reassignment and shared Pager timing introduced in 56.2 remain unchanged.
